prompt:
Create one clean 4K landscape architectural cutaway illustration of a small humble ancient Chinese courtyard used for teaching songs. One single empty location, no people. A very high view from the SOUTH looking NORTH: north is the upper edge, west is left, east is right. Remove the roof and lower the near south wall enough to see the full continuous courtyard floor and useful paths.
At NORTH there is a low one-storey timber and gray-plaster house, a shallow tiled eave, a plain door and a small window. At SOUTH there is one narrow open courtyard gate leading into a lane. Keep the path from this gate to the house clear. On the WEST side a simple clothesline runs NORTH TO SOUTH, with just TWO plain cloth pieces high enough that their lower edges do not obscure a seated person's hands. The east half is lighter and open.
In the EAST half beneath open sky, place exactly THREE small, separate, square, SINGLE-PERSON wooden stools. Each seat is only wide enough for one person. Arrange them in a COMPACT TRIANGLE, one stool to the north and two stools side by side to its south. The two southern stools are separated by one narrow hand-sized gap. The gap between the north stool and the southern pair is about half a stool width. All three sitters could pass a small object directly hand to hand without standing up. The empty center between the three stools is tiny. Do not align the stools in a column, do not spread them along a wall, and do not use long benches. Leave space to walk around the whole compact group without entering the south-to-north gate path. No tables or extra chairs.
The courtyard floor is flat pale worn stone; the walls are low, clean gray plaster with restrained brown framing. Soft afternoon daylight enters from the east with gentle readable shade under the north eave. Clean hand-drawn 2D animation background, fine uniform outlines, broad flat muted warm-gray and blue-gray colors, only two simple values of shading, very low texture density. No photographic texture, paper grain, shiny surfaces, gritty noise, writing, labels, arrows, numbers, diagrams, music symbols, props, people or animals. Show the complete useful layout inside the frame.
